text:
Marta: Dropping the new timeline variant prototype. Main change: per-variant compact summary row with an optional expand overlay. Wanted feedback on microcopy and keyboard flow. Leah: nice! compact summary reads cleaner. question: does the expand open inline or as an overlay? inline can shift layout which is jarring. Devon: overlay on small screens + inline on desktop is fine, but if inline causes horizontal shift we should pin the timeline width. otherwise content jumps. Chi: copy nit: the expand toggle label is currently 'More info' 9999999- maybe use 'View details' for clarity and screen-readers. Riley: for the rollback CTA, instead of 'Rollback now' try 'Revert rollout' or 'Revert variant' 999999- less like a panic button. Marta: good points. I like 'View details' and 'Revert rollout'. I'll update. Also: should the summary row show a single metric (error rate) or a small set (latency + error)? Leah: PMs want at-a-glance: error rate + traffic %. keep it short. expand shows the rest. Devon: accessibility: when opening the details overlay, focus must move into it and be trapped until closed. if inline, avoid trapping; instead, ensure the expand button toggles aria-expanded and announce the key values. aria-bot: A11y reminder: expand control needs role=button, aria-expanded, and aria-controls. overlay should have role=dialog, aria-modal=true, and focus management. slider needs aria-valuetext and keyboard support. Chi: sample announcement suggestion: 'Variant B details opened. Allocation 15 percent. Error rate 0.9%. Last 5 minutes.' keeps SR users informed. Riley: microcopy for confirm step: headline: 'Confirm revert', body: 'This will stop traffic to Variant B and route to previous stable version. Estimated impact: +0.8% error.' buttons: 'Cancel' and 'Revert variant'. Marta: on iconography: current icon is a filled square for stop 9999999- agreed that feels harsh. propose a left-pointing arrow in a circle to imply 'go back'. Leah: also consider color semantics: using red for revert might escalate anxiety. maybe use amber + confirm text to signal caution without alarm. Devon: code snippet for slider aria we've used in infra docs (feel free to port): ```html
``` Chi: keyboard order proposal: focus hit the variant chip -> expand button -> allocation slider -> actions menu -> confirm button. keeps natural left-to-right flow. Riley: one more UX ask: when collapsed, add a tiny sparkline for error trend. fast scanable and helps decide whether to expand. Marta: agree on sparkline. I'll add it. also will change label to 'View details', update revert copy, swap icon to arrow, and use amber for the action. Leah: mobile: when overlay opens, show a condensed header with the variant name, allocation, and a single-line impact estimate so users don't have to scroll. Devon: engineering feasibility: overlay + inline hybrid is doable but we need to ensure we reuse the same DOM so keyboard SR announcements remain consistent. I'll sync with Marta after Figma update. aria-bot: Checklist: add aria-live region for metric updates, ensure dialog has accessible name, include keyboard-only visible focus styles, and test with VoiceOver and NVDA. Marta: thanks team. plan: I'll update the Figma and post links + copy by EOD. target: ship as a small A/B (10% traffic) after design QA. Chi: I'll draft the SR announcement strings and post in the thread. Riley: will mock the sparkline SVG and add to the component library. Devon: assigning to eng for a tech spike on focus-reuse within overlay. Marta: awesome. linking prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/timeline-variant-compact-2. :rocket:
